issues.detail: control surfaces (spoiler hinge line / chordwise breaks)
issues.problem: The w5 'light breaks' material is lighter than the paint. The spoiler hinge line and the chordwise breaks render as white pinstripes, most clearly in w19A, where a long bright line runs down the inboard spoiler area. Real breaks are faint DARK hairlines (_7250, _7331, KN46).
evidence: code: brk { c: '#7a7f86' } vs paint { c: '#636466' }
issues.fix: In the spoiler block: const brk = { c: '#4c4f53', r: 0.95, m: 0 }; (about 0.8x paint, still lighter than gap #1e2228). Keep width 0.014. Target in w19A col ~700: lum 8-15 % UNDER the surrounding skin, never above it.

issues.problem: The tail ends in a flat near-vertical cut. The end cap is RE = 0.12 m on a last section about 0.29*0.85 = 0.25 m deep, so the three cap sections collapse into a face. From 26K/30K the pods read as truncated bricks with a chamfer. KN46 (from above and behind, cruise) shows a rounded bullet end, and _7250 an angled taper. The flanks also show little round-body gradient against the bright-top-to-dark-keel shading in KN46.
issues.fix: In the canoe loop: RE 0.12 -> 0.40. Replace the end-cap loop with for (const u of [0.3, 0.55, 0.75, 0.9, 0.98]) { const e = Math.sqrt(1 - u * u); secs.push(sec(x1 + u * RE, Math.max(0.04, 0.32 * e), Math.max(0.04, 0.30 * e))); }, so it closes as a semi-ellipsoid. Raise the section rounding to r: Math.min(w * 0.48, d * 0.46) for a round keel. Keep x1 = te + 0.30*len - RE so the overall length is unchanged.

issues.problem: The monogram is a generic thin outline ring with block sans-serif 'GE' at 2.0 m / -30 deg. In knav 7A _9 (ANA 77W, inboard side) it is a filled dark script GE monogram with its swirls, about 55-60 deg below the horizontal, near the bottom of the cowl, just aft of the first split.
evidence: /tmp/claude-0/ratA6/p9_ge.png (crop of ref/web/exterior/b5_knav_ANA77W_7A_GE90_takeoff_9.jpg, logo at ~(300,320) right behind the split, near the keel)
issues.fix: In the GE monogram block: xc 2.0 -> 1.65, ac -30 deg -> -57 deg, ring radius 0.22 -> 0.24 with tube 0.014 -> 0.03. Replace the block 'G'/'E' polylines with script swashes (three curling strokes, each an arc of r 0.06-0.10 with a tail running out to the ring), tube 0.028, so the mark reads as a filled dark disc pattern. Colour #2a2f3a.

issues.problem: The liner luminance is now right, but it is sky-blue (b-r +0x2e to +0x35). Real liners are near-neutral (+0x12 in _136, about 0 in knav _9). The m 0.3 mirrors the blue sky.
issues.fix: Inlet material { c: '#7d838a', r: 0.45, m: 0.3 } -> { c: '#7e7f80', r: 0.65, m: 0.05 }. Keep the shadeVerts grading.

issues.problem: The skin is still clean CG. There are no red/black placards on the inboard spoilers/flaps, which KN41 and _7250 show (small red-ringed marks near the walkway at _7250 ~(285,550)). The LE head-dot/slat fringe still aliases at the far LE in w17K.
issues.fix: Add 3 placards per side: wingLine(B, side, [[s-0.12,x],[s+0.12,x]], { c: '#9a2a2a', r: 0.8 }, 0.12) at s 5.0/7.5/13.0, x = spF(s) - 0.4 (inboard: 37.4). Head-dot loop: s < 22 -> s < 17.

issues.problem: From 17K the glyphs collapse into stacked horizontal streaks (the chordwise strokes are foreshortened away) and the text is not readable. KN41, from a similar over-wing angle, stays legible because its strokes are thinner relative to the glyph height and the letters are spaced tightly.
issues.fix: Stroke 0.31 -> 0.26 and pitch 1.15 -> 1.0 (sC = 13.5 + k * 1.0), u scale 0.9 -> 0.85, so the glyphs pack like the photo. Re-check that w26K still shows 'JA' clearly.

issues.problem: These are lighting-owned and not counted in the score. (1) s26K: the wing is still saturated royal blue (#3a4474 skin) and the canoes deep navy. (2) n19A: the canoes are washed dark red by the belly beacon, which reads as red-painted canoes. (3) w11K: the sun-side cowl still clips to #dadfe2.
